policy: Krea 2 Turbo may not be installed or executed until the exact ComfyUI core/custom-node schema is verified in a live pinned runtime.

findings.finding: The primary Krea2EditModelPatch contract exposes VAE and source_image inputs for fit mode; the generated graph supplies both from the approved composite and Krea VAE.
The primary node documentation identifies 768 pixels as the grounded-encode default and describes a trained range beginning at 512; the generated graph locks grounding_px to 768.

The pinned ComfyUI nodes.py DualCLIPLoader type choices do not include krea2, while the Krea graph requires the Krea 2 loader contract. A newer verified core or an exact compatible node implementation is required; changing the type blindly would make the workflow less safe, not more loadable.
ComfyUI, the Krea custom node checkout, and the required model artifacts are not installed; node import, model loading, graph load, and an eight-step Turbo execution remain unverified.

conclusion: The workflows are structurally delivered but Krea live compatibility is not proven. Installation and generation remain fail-closed until a verified compatible ComfyUI revision/node signature is installed and exercised.
